import json
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
a=['baseline dot']*5
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for x,m in zip(items,a):
  f.write(json.dumps(dict(item_id=x['item_id'],answer=next(k for k,v in x['options'].items() if v==m),confidence='high',note=''))+'\n')
